ROOT.NAME: Summary PPG
ROOT.QUERY: /***********************************************************************/ /* Query : PPG list with different retails */ /* Compare retails on overlapping date segments (not exact AVEPRIX */ /* start/end). Report only windows where distinct unit retail > 1. */ /***********************************************************************/ WITH item_prices AS ( SELECT dl.dlinlis, dl.dlicinv, av.avintar, av.aviprix, NVL(av.avimulti, 1) AS avimulti, av.aviprix || ''/'' || NVL(av.avimulti, 1) AS retail_display, GREATEST(av.aviddeb, TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1)) AS aviddeb, av.avidfin FROM artdetlist@heinens_custom_prod dl, aveprix@heinens_custom_prod av WHERE dl.dlicinv = av.avicinv AND dl.dlinlis LIKE ''PPG%'' AND av.avidfin >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) AND dl.dlidfin >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM artuc@heinens_custom_prod, artvl@heinens_custom_prod WHERE araseqvl = arlseqvl AND arlcinluvc = dlicinv AND avidfin > TRUNC(araddeb) AND TRUNC(aradfin) > aviddeb AND pkresrel.isSiteBelongToNode@heinens_custom_prod(1, arasite, ''1100'', ''1'') = 1 ) ), boundaries AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dlinlis, avintar, bound_dt FROM ( SELECT dlinlis, avintar, aviddeb AS bound_dt FROM item_prices UNION SELECT dlinlis, avintar, avidfin + 1 FROM item_prices ) ), segments AS ( SELECT dlinlis, avintar, bound_dt AS seg_start, LEAD(bound_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar ORDER BY bound_dt) - 1 AS seg_end FROM boundaries ), segment_prices AS ( SELECT s.dlinlis, s.avintar, s.seg_start, s.seg_end, ip.dlicinv, ip.aviprix, ip.avimulti, ip.retail_display FROM segments s JOIN item_prices ip ON ip.dlinlis = s.dlinlis AND ip.avintar = s.avintar AND s.seg_end >= ip.aviddeb AND ip.avidfin >= s.seg_start WHERE s.seg_end IS NOT NULL AND s.seg_end >= s.seg_start ), price_check AS ( SELECT dlinlis, dlicinv, avintar, aviprix, avimulti, retail_display, seg_start AS aviddeb, seg_end AS avidfin, COUNT(DISTINCT retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end) AS distinct_retails, FIRST_VALUE(retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end ORDER BY aviprix / avimulti, retail_display) AS min_retail, FIRST_VALUE(retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end ORDER BY aviprix / avimulti DESC, retail_display DESC) AS max_retail FROM segment_prices ), price_flags AS ( SELECT dlinlis, avintar, aviddeb, avidfin, dlicinv, retail_display, min_retail, max_retail, distinct_retails, CASE WHEN retail_display = min_retail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_min, CASE WHEN retail_display = max_retail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_max FROM price_check WHERE distinct_retails > 1 ) SELECT dlinlis "Item list", avintar "Price list", TO_CHAR(aviddeb, ''MM/DD/RR'') "Retail on", TO_CHAR(avidfin, ''MM/DD/RR'') "Retail end", SUM(is_min) || '' item(s) at '' || min_retail "Nb items at min", SUM(is_max) || '' item(s) at '' || max_retail "Nb items at max", COUNT(*) "Total items", distinct_retails "Distinct retails" FROM price_flags GROUP BY dlinlis, avintar, aviddeb, avidfin, min_retail, max_retail, distinct_retails ORDER BY dlinlis, avintar, aviddeb, avidfin
ROOT.QUERY2: /***********************************************************************/ /* Query : PPG item details with different retails (overlap segments) */ /***********************************************************************/ WITH item_prices AS ( SELECT dl.dlinlis, dl.dlicinv, av.avintar, av.aviprix, NVL(av.avimulti, 1) AS avimulti, av.aviprix || ''/'' || NVL(av.avimulti, 1) AS retail_display, av.aviddeb AS item_aviddeb, av.avidfin AS item_avidfin, GREATEST(av.aviddeb, TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1)) AS aviddeb, av.avidfin FROM artdetlist@heinens_custom_prod dl, aveprix@heinens_custom_prod av WHERE dl.dlicinv = av.avicinv AND dl.dlinlis LIKE ''PPG%'' AND av.avidfin >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) AND dl.dlidfin >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM artuc@heinens_custom_prod, artvl@heinens_custom_prod WHERE araseqvl = arlseqvl AND arlcinluvc = dlicinv AND avidfin > TRUNC(araddeb) AND TRUNC(aradfin) > aviddeb AND pkresrel.isSiteBelongToNode@heinens_custom_prod(1, arasite, ''1100'', ''1'') = 1 ) ), boundaries AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dlinlis, avintar, bound_dt FROM ( SELECT dlinlis, avintar, aviddeb AS bound_dt FROM item_prices UNION SELECT dlinlis, avintar, avidfin + 1 FROM item_prices ) ), segments AS ( SELECT dlinlis, avintar, bound_dt AS seg_start, LEAD(bound_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar ORDER BY bound_dt) - 1 AS seg_end FROM boundaries ), segment_prices AS ( SELECT s.dlinlis, s.avintar, s.seg_start, s.seg_end, ip.dlicinv, ip.aviprix, ip.avimulti, ip.retail_display, ip.item_aviddeb, ip.item_avidfin FROM segments s JOIN item_prices ip ON ip.dlinlis = s.dlinlis AND ip.avintar = s.avintar AND s.seg_end >= ip.aviddeb AND ip.avidfin >= s.seg_start WHERE s.seg_end IS NOT NULL AND s.seg_end >= s.seg_start ), price_check AS ( SELECT dlinlis, dlicinv, avintar, aviprix, avimulti, retail_display, item_aviddeb, item_avidfin, seg_start, seg_end, COUNT(DISTINCT retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end) AS distinct_retails, FIRST_VALUE(retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end ORDER BY aviprix / avimulti, retail_display) AS min_retail, FIRST_VALUE(retail_display) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end ORDER BY aviprix / avimulti DESC, retail_display DESC) AS max_retail FROM segment_prices ), price_counts AS ( SELECT pc.*, SUM(CASE WHEN retail_display = min_retail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end) AS items_at_min, SUM(CASE WHEN retail_display = max_retail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY dlinlis, avintar, seg_start, seg_end) AS items_at_max FROM price_check pc WHERE distinct_retails > 1 ) SELECT pc.dlinlis "Item list", pc.avintar "Price list", TO_CHAR(pc.item_aviddeb, ''MM/DD/RR'') "Retail on", TO_CHAR(pc.item_avidfin, ''MM/DD/RR'') "Retail end", uv.arvcexr || ''/'' || uv.arvcexv "Item/SV code", pkstrucobj.get_desc@heinens_custom_prod(1, uv.arvcinr, ''HN'') "Item desc.", pc.retail_display "Retail", pc.min_retail "Min retail", pc.items_at_min "Nb items min retail", pc.max_retail "Max retail", pc.items_at_max "Nb items max retail" FROM price_counts pc, artuv@heinens_custom_prod uv WHERE pc.dlicinv = uv.arvcinv ORDER BY pc.dlinlis, pc.avintar, pc.seg_start, pc.seg_end, pc.item_aviddeb, pc.aviprix / pc.avimulti, pc.dlicinv
